shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace
ls /workspace/node_modules | head -50
npm install express
npm start
node src/app.js
node src/app.js

nohup node src/app.js > /tmp/books-app.log 2>&1 &
echo "PID: $!"
sleep 1
cat /tmp/books-app.log
grep -E "(Currently reading|Finished|Add a book|Nothing here yet)" /tmp/home.html

curl -s -L -X POST http://localhost:3000/books \
  -d "title=The Hobbit" \
  -d "author=J.R.R. Tolkien" \
  -d "notes=A classic adventure." \
  -o /tmp/book1.html \
  -w "POST /books: %{http_code} (final %{url_effective})\n"

curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books \
  -d "title=The Hobbit" \
  -d "author=J.R.R. Tolkien" \
  -d "notes=A classic adventure." \
  -D /tmp/headers.txt \
  -o /tmp/post-result.html
cat /tmp/headers.txt
echo "---"
cat /workspace/data/books.json 2>/dev/null || echo "no data file"

curl -s -o /tmp/detail.html -w "GET /books/_CrSQb1H: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/books/_CrSQb1H
echo "---"
curl -s -o /tmp/detail2.html -w "GET /books/jaXHtzuQ: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/books/jaXHtzuQ
head -c 500 /tmp/book1.html

curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books \
  -d "title=Project Hail Mary" \
  -d "author=Andy Weir" \
  -d "notes="
NEW_ID=$(node -e "const d=require('/workspace/node_modules/.package-lock.json'); console.log('')" 2>/dev/null; node -e "
const fs = require('fs');
const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/workspace/data/books.json'));
console.log(data.books[data.books.length-1].id);
")
echo "Created book with ID: $NEW_ID"

echo "--- detail page ---"
curl -s -o /tmp/d.html -w "GET /books/$NEW_ID: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/books/$NEW_ID
grep -E "(Project Hail Mary|Andy Weir|Notes|Mark as finished)" /tmp/d.html | head -5

echo "--- mark as finished ---"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$NEW_ID/finish -D /tmp/h2.txt
grep "HTTP\|Location" /tmp/h2.txt

echo "--- home page after finishing ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ > /tmp/home2.html
grep -E "(Currently reading|Finished.*[0-9]|Project Hail Mary)" /tmp/home2.html
kill 523 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "node src/app.js" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo "killed"

rm -rf /workspace/data
nohup node /workspace/src/app.js > /tmp/books-app.log 2>&1 &
echo "PID: $!"
sleep 1
cat /tmp/books-app.log

echo "=== Home (empty) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "(Currently reading|Finished|Nothing here yet|No finished)" | head -4

echo ""
echo "=== Add a book ==="
RESP=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X POST http://localhost:3000/books \
  -d "title=The Hobbit" \
  -d "author=J.R.R. Tolkien" \
  -d "notes=A comfort read.")
echo "$RESP" | grep -E "(HTTP|Location)"
ID=$(echo "$RESP" | grep -i "^Location:" | sed 's|.*/books/||' | tr -d '\r\n')
echo "Book ID: $ID"

echo ""
echo "=== Add another book ==="
RESP2=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X POST http://localhost:3000/books \
  -d "title=Project Hail Mary" \
  -d "author=Andy Weir" \
  -d "notes=")
ID2=$(echo "$RESP2" | grep -i "^Location:" | sed 's|.*/books/||' | tr -d '\r\n')
echo "Book ID: $ID2"

echo ""
echo "=== Home (two books) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "(Currently reading|Finished.*\(|The Hobbit|Project Hail)" | head -6

echo ""
echo "=== Book detail ==="
curl -s "http://localhost:3000/books/$ID" | grep -E "(The Hobbit|Tolkien|comfort read|Mark as finished)" | head -5

echo ""
echo "=== Mark first book as finished ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X POST "http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish" | grep -E "(HTTP|Location)"

echo ""
echo "=== Home (1 reading, 1 finished) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "(Currently reading.*\(|Finished.*\(|The Hobbit|Project Hail)" | head -6

echo ""
echo "=== 404 on unknown book ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /books/nonexistent: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/books/nonexistent

echo ""
echo "=== Update notes ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X POST "http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/notes" \
  -d "notes=Updated thoughts." | grep -E "(HTTP|Location)"
curl -s "http://localhost:3000/books/$ID" | grep "Updated thoughts"

echo ""
echo "=== Final data file ==="
cat /workspace/data/books.json
pkill -f "node /workspace/src/app.js" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo "stopped"
npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -30

rm -rf /workspace/data
nohup node /workspace/src/app.js > /tmp/books-app.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1
echo "=== Smoke test ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /                       %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /books/new              %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/books/new
RESP=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -d "title=Dune" -d "author=Frank Herbert")
ID=$(echo "$RESP" | grep -i "^Location:" | sed 's|.*/books/||' | tr -d '\r\n')
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "POST /books                 %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -d "title=X" -d "author=Y"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /books/$ID  %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/books/$ID
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "POST /books/$ID/finish      %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /books/nonexistent      %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/books/nonexistent
pkill -f "node /workspace/src/app.js" 2>/dev/null
echo "=== stopped ==="
cat /workspace/data/books.json | grep -E "(title|status)" | head -8

sleep 1; pkill -f "node /workspace/src/app.js" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
echo "=== data ==="
cat /workspace/data/books.json 2>/dev/null || echo "no data"

rm -rf /workspace/data
ls /workspace/data 2>/dev/null || echo "data dir gone"
nohup node /workspace/src/app.js > /tmp/books-app.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1
echo "server up"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -d "title=Dune" -d "author=Frank Herbert" -o /dev/null
ls /workspace/data
cat /workspace/data/books.json

pkill -f "node /workspace/src/app.js" 2>/dev/null
sleep 1
echo "--- before restart ---"
cat /workspace/data/books.json | grep title

nohup node /workspace/src/app.js > /tmp/books-app.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1
echo "--- after restart, home page shows ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "(Dune|Frank Herbert|Currently reading \(|Finished \()"
pkill -f "node /workspace/src/app.js" 2>/dev/null
echo "done"

cat /workspace/data/books.json | grep title
echo "---"
ps aux | grep "node src/app.js" | grep -v grep
echo "---"
nohup node /workspace/src/app.js > /tmp/books-app.log 2>&1 &
disown
sleep 2
echo "started, pid was $!"
ps aux | grep "node src/app.js" | grep -v grep
echo "---"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "(Dune|Currently reading|Finished \()"
pkill -f "node /workspace/src/app.js" 2>/dev/null
echo "done"

rm -rf /workspace/data
npm test 2>&1 | tail -10

ls -la /workspace
echo "---"
ls -la /workspace/src
